response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems experience with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks direct executive leadership experience in fintech or regulated environments. His background in agentic workflows and event-driven systems is relevant, though not at the scale or seniority required for this CTO role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators, agentic workflows at re:cinq).
Proven track record in designing and scaling event-driven, distributed systems (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby media).
Diverse technical expertise across languages, frameworks, and domains (fintech-adjacent, real-time systems, observability).
concerns: No explicit executive leadership experience (e.g., scaling teams from 10 to 30+, CTO/VP-level roles).
Limited fintech-specific experience (e.g., credit systems, regulatory compliance, real-time risk modeling).
Agentic AI work appears more prototypical (e.g., GISCollective) rather than production-grade in high-stakes environments.
